answer: Access to ocean and marble survey datasets uses paid, expiring identities. Each key burns 40 credits per epoch and locks 120 for 20 epochs; its maximum payout is 25. A contract grants one seat per key-bound burn receipt and rejects reuse. Twelve beacon-timed checks require signed replies within 30 seconds; a missing signal burns half the bond. Anyone can audit balances, receipt nullifiers and deadlines. Each extra fake key adds 40 irreversible credits and 120 locked credits, so n fakes pay 40n and immobilize 120n.
